घुण् {vI.v} A., {c6c} P. (घोणते, घुणति,
घुणित) To roll, whirl, stagger, reel.
{vII.v} {c1c} A. To take, receive.

घुणः [घुण्-क] A particular kind
of insect found in timber.
--Comp.
--अक्षरं, --लिपिः f. an incision in
wood or in the leaf of a book made
by an insect or worm and
resembling somewhat the form of a letter.
˚न्यायः see under न्याय.
